Five starting colors, thirteen wells, and a flower palette full of surprises. Enjoy satisfying color mixing ASMR as the pigments swirl into glowing new shades, one petal at a time. Watch yellow and blue become Plasma Teal, then follow the next mixes through Electric Violet, Solar Orange, Neon Pink and Graphite. There is a twist in the next petal: Pearl White meets the Electric Violet made earlier to create soft Ice Violet. Reactor Gold completes the outer mixes before all five starting colors come together in the center for the Midnight Plasma reveal. Take a relaxing moment to follow the glossy paint textures, bright streaks and changing shades from the first scoop to the finished palette. Try guessing each result before the colors fully blend. Which petal would you pick, and what color combination should we try next? #ColorMixing #PaintMixing #Satisfying #ASMR
